content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): B.E/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering or equivalent with 65% or 6.5 CGPA AND/OR M.E/M.Tech in Quantum/VLSI/Microelectronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering or equivalent with 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIIT Bhagalpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur (IIIT Bhagalpur) for a project-based position under a DST sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under advertisement number IITBH/R&C/506/2026/62.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIIT Bhagalpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Computer Science & Engineering, Quantum, VLSI, or Microelectronics with required percentage or CGPA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates are required to directly attend the walk-in interview at the designated venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment at IIIT Bhagalpur is scheduled for 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original academic and experience certificates, publications, a valid photo identity proof, and self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification details?
faq.answer: You can check and download the official notification PDF using the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
